Exposing Freemasonry & Secret Societies
Is Freemasonry really what people say...or what they think it is? What if the symbols hidden in your church are related? This video pulls back the veil on Freemasonry, exposing its roots in Egyptian sun worship, phallic reverence, planetary deities, and occult fertility rites. From the infamous "G" to the obelisk and the sacred wafer lifted before the sun, we follow the trail of symbolism that links modern religion to a much older, darker worship. Unearthing it all! Watch closely—what you think is holy may have been claimed by another god altogether and if it's in your family, you may be also.
